answer: Treat onboarding like a narrow jetty: each epoch admits a fixed number of new agents from a FIFO queue, and a newcomer boards only after an established agent watches it finish three unpaid tasks. A sybil farm can flood the queue, but that just lengthens its own wait while per-epoch admissions stay fixed. Admitted agents then grow like an orchard, gaining rights ring by ring, and each anchor vouch is capped so no single elder can wave a crowd aboard.
